title: Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY
description: Provides health insurance cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization and major disease coverage.
offlineInfo: Apply at nearest CSC or empanelled hospital.

title: National Health Mission (NHM)
description: Strengthens rural and urban healthcare systems.
benefits: Maternal care, child health, disease control programs.
offlineInfo: Contact district health office.

title: Jan Aushadhi Scheme
benefits: Low-cost medicines through Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
offlineInfo: Visit nearest Jan Aushadhi store.

title: National TB Elimination Program
description: Free diagnosis and treatment for Tuberculosis.
benefits: Free medicines and nutritional support.
offlineInfo: Visit nearest government health centre.

title: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Health insurance scheme for economically weaker sections in Maharashtra.
benefits: Free hospitalization and surgeries.
offlineInfo: Visit empanelled government hospitals in Maharashtra.
